section.12: The Book of The At-Tatbiq (Clasping One's Hands Together)

12.name_native: The Book of The At-Tatbiq (Clasping One's Hands Together)

hadiths.text: It was narrated that Ali said:"The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) forbade me from wearing Al-Qassi, and clothes dyed from safflower, and from wearing gold rings, and from reciting Qura'n while bowing
